title: Add Deterministic Continuous Improvement Signals
intent: Convert terminal Work evidence into derived, structured improvement signals that Spec can analyze
motivation: Codepatrol already records attempts, traces, results, artifacts, execution identities, and terminal outcomes, but continuous improvement depends on an agent reading raw evidence and spotting patterns manually. The capability stays read-only and derived, and never creates or applies Works automatically. Non-goals: no automatic Work creation, no automatic Initiative application, no permanent analytics database, no opaque score that replaces evidence.
ordering: Contract first, then lifecycle and verification aggregates, then correlations, then the inspect command, then Spec discovery, then the evaluation suites that keep it honest. Read-only until outputs are stable.
